ollama-nomic-embed-text.problem: Build semantic search over internal manuals, support tickets and other text documents.

integration: Use the existing pinned Ollama recipe and connect a client to its embedding API.
Add a vector index with consistent document/query preprocessing; compare results on real searches.
notes: Evaluate the actual language mix and retrieval quality before choosing this over the multilingual alternatives.

ollama-nomic-embed-text-v2-moe.problem: Find related documents even when a question and its source material use different languages.
ollama-nomic-embed-text-v2-moe.summary: Nomic Embed Text v2 MoE is a multilingual mixture-of-experts embedding model for retrieval and similarity tasks.

Add a vector index with consistent document/query preprocessing; compare results on real searches.
notes: The reviewed recipe has a 512-token context; split longer documents before indexing.

ollama-granite3-2-vision.problem: Answer questions about document pages, tables and charts without relying only on text extracted by OCR.

Add a bounded image upload workflow and evaluate outputs against representative source images.

ollama-llama3-2-vision.problem: Describe photos and answer questions about the objects, text and relationships visible in an image.
ollama-llama3-2-vision.summary: Llama 3.2 Vision combines image understanding with text generation; this catalog keeps its incompatible upstream artifact download-only.

Add a bounded image upload workflow and evaluate outputs against representative source images.
notes: The current official Llama 3.2 GGUF uses mllama, which Ollama 0.40.16's llama-server cannot load (unknown model architecture). Downloads are retained; deployment requires a compatible artifact/runtime qualification. Llama 4 Scout remains a separate recipe.

ollama-qwen3-8-flash-next.problem: Retain the large Flash Next model files for a future host or separately qualified lower-memory serving approach.
ollama-qwen3-8-flash-next.summary: This entry pins the Linux-compatible Q4_K_M GGUF artifact for Qwen3.8 Flash Next, not the separate Apple MLX distribution.
integration: Use the existing pinned Ollama recipe and connect a client to its inference API.
Add a bounded image upload workflow and evaluate outputs against representative source images.
notes: The Linux GGUF is 120 GB. This quantization needs more RAM than a 128 GB Spark safely provides; downloading is allowed, deployment is capacity-checked. MLX variants are not Linux/CUDA replacements.
The reviewed Q4 memory budget exceeds this Spark's safe capacity. Downloaded files do not imply that inference can start.

strata-qwen38.problem: Evaluate whether a smaller quantization can serve the large Qwen Flash Next family within Spark memory.

Measure correctness, memory and API readiness before registering a workload profile.
notes: This remains an experimental integration, not a managed deployment recipe.

ncm-tinystories.problem: Research and compare an experimental model architecture on a bounded text-generation workload.
ncm-tinystories.summary: NCM is a research project with published code and evaluation checkpoints.
integration: Review the code/checkpoints and build a qualified CUDA runtime.
Use a reproducible TinyStories evaluation before considering a production service.
notes: A research workload does not provide an established business service by itself.

basalt.problem: Explore an alternative inference runtime after verifying platform compatibility.
basalt.summary: Basalt is an alternative inference project with platform-specific build requirements.
integration: Review the upstream build targets, dependencies and model support.
An ARM64/GB10 port and native qualification are required before registration.
notes: The upstream x86-64/SM120 build is not qualified for this Spark.
